note: Monthly refresh: status lines, new frameworks or rule changes.

frameworks.d: SEBI's ESG report for the top 1,000 listed companies, built on the nine NGRBC principles.
Nine KPI attributes needing independent assessment or assurance, phased by market cap.
frameworks.status: Top 1,000 in FY 2026-27; value-chain disclosure voluntary.

frameworks.d: National Guidelines on Responsible Business Conduct — successor to the 2011 NVGs and the backbone of BRSR.
Mandatory CSR spend of 2% of average net profit for qualifying companies.
Intensity-based carbon market: binding GHG emission-intensity targets for obligated industrial plants.
frameworks.status: ~490 entities with targets for 2025-26 and 2026-27 (FY24 baseline).

frameworks.d: Market-based credits for environmental actions such as tree plantation; disclosed as a BRSR leadership indicator.
Directions on climate finance and climate-risk management for banks and NBFCs; a climate-risk information system (RBI-CRIS).
frameworks.status: Final climate disclosure norms reported as deferred (2026).

frameworks.d: SEBI regulates ESG rating providers (e.g. CRISIL ESG, ICRA ESG) operating in Indian markets.
Indian standards for sustainability and GHG assurance used for BRSR Core.
The most widely used impact-reporting standard; topic standards plus sector standards.
frameworks.status: GRI 101 Biodiversity effective 2026; GRI 102 Climate and 103 Energy from 2027.

frameworks.d: Global baseline for investor-focused sustainability and climate disclosure; adopted into law by many jurisdictions.
frameworks.status: 35 jurisdictions adopted by Jul 2026; India consulting on S2 for finance.

frameworks.d: 77 industry-specific metric sets, now maintained by the ISSB and used with IFRS S1.
Value-creation reporting across six capitals; IFRS Foundation guidance links it with IFRS S1/S2.
Climate disclosure recommendations (governance, strategy, risk, metrics) — fully built into IFRS S2.
frameworks.status: Task force disbanded 2023; monitoring passed to ISSB.

frameworks.d: Nature-related risk and opportunity disclosures using the LEAP approach.
frameworks.status: 836 adopters; technical work complete; ISSB nature practice statement in development.

frameworks.d: Investor and customer questionnaire on climate, water and forests; feeds supplier and investor scores.
The accounting rules for Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions used by almost every framework.
Validates corporate emissions-reduction and net-zero targets against climate science.
Ten principles on human rights, labour, environment and anti-corruption; annual Communication on Progress.
17 Sustainable Development Goals — the common language for mapping CSR and ESG impact.

frameworks.n: UN Guiding Principles on Business & Human Rights
frameworks.d: Protect, respect, remedy — the basis for human-rights due diligence laws.
Responsible business conduct expectations, updated in 2023 (climate, tech, value chains).
Six principles for responsible investment signed by asset owners and managers.
Environmental and social risk standards for project finance.
Guidance (not certifiable) on social responsibility.
Certifiable systems for environment, health & safety, energy, and GHG quantification.
Social accountability (labour) certification; B Corp whole-company impact certification.
International sustainability assurance standards.

frameworks.n: MSCI, Sustainalytics, S&P CSA (DJSI), FTSE4Good, ISS ESG
frameworks.d: Major ESG ratings and indices used by investors.
EU sustainability reporting with double materiality under ESRS.
frameworks.status: Scope now >1,000 employees and >€450m turnover; non-EU groups with €450m EU turnover; wave 2 from FY2027.

frameworks.d: Human-rights and environmental due diligence across value chains.
Classification of environmentally sustainable activities; KPI disclosure for in-scope firms.
Sustainability disclosures for financial-market participants and products.
Carbon price on imports of cement, iron & steel, aluminium, fertilisers, hydrogen and electricity — relevant for Indian exporters.
UK-endorsed versions of IFRS S1 and S2.
frameworks.status: Published 25 Feb 2026; FCA consulting on listing-rule use.

frameworks.d: 2024 federal climate disclosure rule for listed companies.
frameworks.status: Stayed since 2024; SEC proposed full rescission on 29 May 2026.

frameworks.d: Scope 1-3 emissions (SB 253, >$1bn revenue) and climate-risk reports (SB 261, >$500m) for companies doing business in California.
ISSB-aligned climate reporting for large Australian entities.

frameworks.n: China CSDS, Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan SSBJ
frameworks.d: ISSB-aligned regimes across major Asian markets, phased by listing tier.
frameworks.status: China CSDS and Philippines adopted in 2026; Hong Kong from 2025.
